title: Agent 1 extract output (candidate field batch)
description: Structured-output contract for extract. MUST NOT contain page / bbox - position is located back in the source by the system.

key.description: Field key; must come from fields.yaml (fields outside the dictionary are routed to extra_fields by normalize)

raw_value.description: The raw value copied back by the model, not normalized; case and spelling must match the source

span.description: Smallest locatable fragment; no field labels such as "Applicant:"; must be copied verbatim from the source

label.description: The field's label as written in the source, shown in the review console

confidence.description: Ranking within this stage only; MUST NOT be written into FieldValue (the contract has no such field)
